# TASK-156 — specification

## Scope

Document evidence diagrams through MCP: derive section evidence maps from canonical answers, render through an administrator-allowlisted MCP tool, generate missing diagrams in a bounded batch after an explicit action, and propose rather than write. Include accepted diagrams in specification, PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md exports. Preserve local-only restrictions, revision checks, failure isolation and diagram feature gates. Semantic architecture inference and unattended regeneration remain deferred.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] MCP is a renderer, not a Markdown reasoning engine.
- [ ] Produce deterministic evidence maps from recorded answers and section labels, with no invented relationships.
- [ ] A user may request the current section or all missing diagrams; the configured renderer must be allowlisted and read-only.
- [ ] Each successful result becomes a reviewable proposal tied to its source revision.
- [ ] Report per-section failures, retain existing diagrams, and prevent duplicates for unchanged inputs.
- [ ] Accepted diagrams accompany generated specification, product and design documents.
- [ ] Never call external renderers for local-only projects.
- [ ] Deeper semantic diagrams and unattended refresh are separate follow-ups.
